authorization_basis: User authorized as many bounded live audio runs as necessary, fixed the external world source at device 2 / 180 degrees / 50 cm, confirmed the Mac mini self source centered 4 cm below the array at 100 percent system volume, and explicitly approved natural-speech workspace binding.

frozen_representation.name: chirp_conditioned_self_prediction_residual_ratio
frozen_representation.threshold_rule: maximum development self-only residual ratio plus 10 percent of the clean gap to minimum development world-only ratio

run_policy: Run all 15 trials once in implementation order. A device-open or source-start failure before playback may be retried unchanged. Once playback begins, retain the acoustic result; do not replace a failed alignment, residual, classification, or clipping result. Any material representation, threshold, source, level, or geometry change requires a new preregistration.
interpretation_rule: A full pass extends H3 support from structured tones to these 12 already-spent natural-speech excerpts at this fixed geometry and level. A failure is retained and leaves the structured-tone H3 result intact.
claim_boundary: The task tests source/event binding under natural-speech spectral overlap, not speech detection or register classification. Commanded recordings are operational self audio because waveform and efference identity are known; they are not Cora-generated language. One room, one XVF3800, two fixed speaker locations, approximate uncalibrated world-speaker knob position, 12 purposeful corpus clips, and a single run do not establish geometry, room, population, device, calibrated-SPL, semantic, or biological transfer.
